title: Baked potato with cottage cheese, beans and salad
steps: Scrub the potato and prick it all over with a fork.
Microwave it on high for 8 to 10 minutes, turning it over halfway, until a knife slides easily into the middle. Or bake it at 200 °C for about an hour.
While it cooks, warm the beans in a small pot or the microwave for 1 to 2 minutes, and wash and chop the lettuce and tomato.
Cut a cross in the top of the potato and squeeze the sides to open it. Spoon in the warm beans, then the cottage cheese, and season with black pepper.
Serve with the salad on the side.
